explore-khz.title: Slide the prefix
explore-khz.prompt: The dial reads 3.525 MHz. Slide to kHz and read the same frequency in kilohertz.
hints: kilo is one stop to the left of mega.
explore-khz.success: 3 525 kHz. One step down the ladder: the decimal point moved three places right.

explore-mv.title: Down to milli
hints: milli is one stop below the base unit.
explore-mv.success: 2 000 mV. Millivolts are smaller, so you need more of them.
